What is QualAI?

QualAI is a modern, AI-powered quality assurance platform. It combines a FastAPI backend, a React frontend, and a Qdrant vector database to deliver intelligent test analysis, similarity search, and scalable automation.

  • AI-driven insights to detect issues faster and improve coverage.
  • Vector search with Qdrant for semantically relevant retrievals.
  • Docker-based setup for reproducible environments.

Getting Started

Get up and running with QualAI in minutes using Docker.

Quick Start with Docker

1. Clone the Repository

git clone https://github.com/your-username/2025W2-QualAI.git

2. Start All Services

docker compose up

3. Access Services

Frontend

http://localhost:5173

Backend

http://localhost:8000

Qdrant

http://localhost:6333
